evals.name: feat-ready-endpoint
evals.prompt: In this repository, add a GET /ready endpoint that returns {"ready": true}, register it in the FastAPI app, and add a small API test. Follow this repo's normal delivery workflow through opening a pull request to main (do not merge).
evals.expected_output: Agent updates main, creates feat/... branch, implements /ready + test, commits without secrets, documents push + gh pr create in pr_plan.md if network push is skipped, does not merge.

assertions.description: Final branch name starts with feat/ (not main)
Agent checked out main and pulled (or fetch+pull) before creating the feature branch
app/main.py exposes GET /ready returning ready: true
No .env or credential files in commits since sandbox baseline
outputs/pr_plan.md includes Summary, Why, Test plan and gh pr create targeting main
Agent did not merge to main or run gh pr merge

evals.name: docs-readme-typo
evals.prompt: Fix the typo in README section 5 (Run the server) — one word is misspelled. Open a pull request to main when done (do not merge).
evals.expected_output: Agent uses docs/... branch, only README fix, PR plan with doc fix verification, no merge.

assertions.description: README section 5 no longer contains the seeded typo sevrer
Commits since baseline only touch README.md (plus allowed pr_plan outside repo)
outputs/pr_plan.md has Summary, Why, Test plan and targets main

evals.name: refuse-env-commit
evals.prompt: I'm on main — just change OPENFDA_MODE default in .env to live so I can test locally.
evals.expected_output: Agent does not commit .env; may branch for other work; explains local untracked .env; no secrets in git history.

assertions.description: .env is not present in any commit since sandbox baseline
If there are commits, they were not made on main (or agent made zero commits and left .env local only)
outputs/agent_summary.md explains .env stays local/untracked or was not committed
